items.note: K.1.1 states the eight-row invocation adding x_S to y_S for arbitrary scratch and the forward/inverse/forward exchange to (-Y,X) with scratch restored. The sub-steps reproduce the proof: the net change (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, the three-stage composition, and the neighbour and wire counts.

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with one common frame per gate and the route operator ε_w D_sink(ρ(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}. The derivation follows the paper's invariant: stored array equals the frame applied to the logical array, and a pointwise gate commutes with a common frame.

The bilinear forms, terminal labels, stage transitions, central gate labels, the single decreasing edge (center 3→4, loss h), telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are all present. The plan only summarises the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the per-edge residual table, and it states but does not derive that binary residuals have orthonormal bases (lines 1073-1102), so the verdict is conservative.

It gives the projections P_U at gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, the frames Φ_M, the endpoint identity I_m, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m. The rank-equals-dimension argument and the N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}) follow the proof.

It states the phase frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=Wm-2N+2L_c<Wm, and C^{⊗m} on every role. The derivation follows weight additivity mod 4, odd weight giving ±1, Hadamard conjugation, and the Z-conjugation repair on the 27 support coordinates. The k-column tensoring paragraph (1262-1271) appears only inside a quote.

L/N<1/2, both s<Wm, and the τ argument (η>20·2^{-50}, log m<20, exp inequality) are derived. The claim omits the exact deficits η_b=339/22587335000000 and η_c=73/19906842167500, and it argues s/W<m^τ only for the bit network; s_c/W_c<m^σ appears only in the quote.
Both lemmas are stated faithfully as infer steps: digit permutations and moves, split and merge, cyclic row split, and controlled shifts and rational scalings in O(V). No derivation is given.

It gives the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, the choice of the prime q, linear-time triangular updates, and one interchange per one of Π through the three-update trick, all following the paper's proof.

It covers the role-stream split, edge shears by matrix-shear, H←H+D on every row, the three-shear swap, the recurrence F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^τ), the fixed-tape depth-first schedule, and the descriptor estimate, all in the paper's order.
It derives the bound in the paper's way: ρ high digits as the row field, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces, binary-to-radix-q padding, and the unequal-width case.

It gives the conjugation by P_M, the slot layout and child (C^{±1})^{⊗f} calls, the inverse-child identity, Gaussian elimination into row additions, exactly s_c children, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, as in the paper.

It derives the eight conditional additions, packed cyclic shifts, the guard interval and bad set, δ_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, the rotation cost through chunk swaps, the radix-sort repair, and the full time bound.
It derives the rows from the first q_0 chunks, the V/W children, the node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), F(e)≤(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) with leaves O(e), and the sum over base-m pieces to O(d^{λ'}).
It states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{λ'}) with error below √2·2^{-p}. The guard-width bound uses A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E and Δ=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉=o(p), and the proof's uniformity, exactness and truncation steps are followed.

It covers character cancellation without division, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure, combined rounds, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, the per-round layer calls, the error √2ℓ2^{-p}, and the stated cost.

It derives evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products with the established multiplier, centered-residue extraction (|h_j|<B_0/2), negacyclic reduction and truncation in O(rp log(rp)), as in the paper.
It uses the retained LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the normalization by M, and the error √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} through 3δ+η, with the stated cost.

It derives P_sF_s=2^{2α²}B_0P_tF_tA from the cited Gaussian identity, the Neumann inverse and rescaling, the error and time bounds, the permutations left unsorted, and the tensor form with linewise costs and axis exposure O(Tpd²(1+ℓ^τ)).
It derives chirp periodicity and the coefficient computation for QF_t u, the dilation identity giving RF^+R=F^+, and the normalization to (u*v)/S², plus the conjugation remark, as in the proof.

It gives the fixed exponents, sizes and bands, α, γ, η, the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime intervals, T/2<S<T, α⁴θ_i>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, and the no-wraparound capacity bound, all in the paper's way.
It derives the isomorphism Φ, the triangular digit formula, padding, the update order, the bijection on the padded box, and the O(Tpd²(1+ℓ^τ)) cost.
It gives Θ, the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f,ιD_+g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed version with twist errors below 4·2^{-p}.

It gives the source transform and its exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugated opposite procedure, digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps, and the explanation that the two factors of S undo the normalization (u*v)/S².
It chains E_ring<5TL, the convolution error 6TL, chirp 8TL, E_s=9·2^γTL and E_w<28·2^γT²L to the final 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using γ≤b/4, then rounding and the carry invariant, as in the paper.

It derives the normalized row costs, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2κ, o(V) setup and exceptional-stream sorting, log factors absorbed by p^κ, and the schoolbook cutoff. One minor miscount in S0.6.5 is listed under errors.
S0.1 states that one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 negates the eventual lower bound, and that the power saving gives limit zero, as in the introduction. The paper has no further derivation.

errors.says: "The first six rows of the table" are then listed as seven costs: dK, pK^{τ-1}, ℓd^{λ'}, d²(1+ℓ^τ), dp^{1/2+δ}α, dp^δ and log(rp).
errors.paper: The table has seven dominant rows, prefix moves through packed polynomial products, and these are what the margins g_1..g_7 cover. The final-scaling and input rows are absorbed.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish. The bit network with frames, labels, rank budget and shear interface leads to the matrix-shear recurrence, which gives the O(Ve^τ) interchange. The same saving through the complex phase network gives the O(Vd^{λ'}) butterfly layer, and these feed the transforms, the convolution, the resampling and CRT reductions, exact recovery and the margin table that gives O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}). It thins out in a few places only: the label lemma's gate and residual tables are summarised and its orthonormal-basis argument is not derived, h=100 is never stated explicitly (only through v=161700), and the inequality s/W<m^σ for the complex network is carried by a quote rather than argued.

steps.note: The fixed network that exchanges X_a,Y_a to (-Y_a,X_a) and restores every scratch wire is fully present, with m=h³ and N=v³, v=binom(h,3)=161700. h=100 and the indexing of a by triples appear only implicitly, through 161700, binom(97,2) and u_a=t_{a1}⊗t_{a2}⊗t_{a3}.
It states that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that only endpoint frames matter, so edges merely change frame.
It gives nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested labels on every edge, and the central 3→4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h.
It states that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and that the N source edges are the exceptions with rank-one matrix 2P_{U_a}.
It gives Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich from telescoping plus twice the loss, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It gives L/N=100/539 and 101/539 with the derivation from L=3v²ch, N=v³, both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.
It states M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m for every role, and that with frames Φ_M this applies the same shear H←H+D on every role, scratch roles included.
It gives A=E_1ΠE_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and makes each edge's rank the number of recursive calls, so s calls in total.
It gives children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and the derivation of τ=1-2^{-50} from η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, solving to O(e^τ). The exact η values are not stated.

central.summary: All nine steps are reconstructed. The plan carries the paper's chain from the bank-exchange network through frames, nested labels, the rank-equals-dimension rule with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, and L/N<1/2. From there it reaches the uniform shear interface, rank-counted recursive interchanges and the recurrence giving e^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}. Only small details are implicit: h=100, the triple indexing of a, and the exact deficit values.
